openings.delta: Change the evidence carrier from stage output digests alone to dictionary-verified equivalent input/output boundaries. Nearest rival: the prior output-gap ledger, which leaves missing transform outputs unresolved even when equivalent successor inputs are available.
openings.prediction: If the dictionary establishes that export inputs represent the missing transform-output boundary, cross-run input comparisons provide additional boundary evidence and may narrow intervals. Without that equivalence, usable inputs, or preceding coverage, intervals persist. Equal later inputs do not exclude earlier divergence or prove execution.
openings.probe: Using the same inspected records, compare output-only and verified-alias ledgers across both disjoint three-pair subsets. Apply the stipulated transform-record removals during final review. Freeze reports, references, next checks and inspection logs before opening answer sheets. Compare supported boundaries and interval coverage; test contrast only where a verified alias changes available evidence.
assumptions: Manifest order supplies an expected sequence, not execution proof or causal explanation; local timestamp anomalies remain recorded.
Dictionary verification must establish artifact-boundary identity. Mere adjacency cannot authorize an alias or a definite stage claim.
Every definite claim cites a supplied record; absent records and blank warnings establish neither nonexecution nor success.
Defeat conditions: unverified equivalence, incomparable digests, earlier uncovered boundaries, or identical variant decisions. No advantage is presumed.
Keep total manual inspections at twelve per pair, construction within sixty minutes and comparison within twenty additional minutes. Reuse inspected evidence after removal.
Next checks identify an uninspected supplied record or manifest/dictionary ambiguity within remaining capacity. Exhausted capacity is explicit; no new equipment or records are assumed.

assessment: One hypothetical refinement. Boundary equivalence is unknown here; fallback intervals preserve constraints. No actual records, divergence locations, timings or performance effects are claimed.
